events.title: Santa's Workshop
events.address: Mountain View Community Center, 201 S. Rengstorff Ave., Mountain View, CA
events.description: Holiday craft morning for kids ages 6-11, including designing ornaments, customizing a stocking and making a snow globe. Registration required.
events.blurb: Design ornaments, customize a stocking, and make a snow globe at a Saturday morning holiday craft session for kids ages 6-11, with registration required.

events.title: Senior Workshop: Google Translate and Digital Emergency Prep
events.address: Social Hall, Mountain View Senior Center, 266 Escuela Avenue, Mountain View, CA
events.description: Workshop on using Google Translate and preparing digitally for emergencies, for adults 55+. Sign up by calling 650-903-6330, stopping by the front desk or emailing the Senior Center.
events.blurb: Learn to use Google Translate and set up your phone and accounts for emergencies in a Thursday afternoon workshop for adults 55 and older.
